name: endesha-salama
description: Motorcycle safety lessons (public) and HSSE work lessons (staff) in Kiswahili and English. No build step: the site is the site/ folder; server/ is the Cloudflare Worker (staff API and admin portal, D1 database).

scripts.server: wrangler d1 migrations apply hsse --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run test:server && wrangler d1 migrations apply hsse --remote && wrangler deploy
